source: Original deterministic Python waveform synthesis in generate.py; no samples, models, network, randomness, system clock or third-party audio.
triggerPolicy: Only an actually committed simulation outcome may start a cue. HUD text, bar fill, countdown text, button enabled state and balance deltas are display projections and must never be diffed to invent an event.

cues.audibleIntent: Two short tones rising a fourth; a compact confirmation that the shop accepted the purchase.

event.label: purchase success
event.consumerAccess: Match.step() results: the submitted buyItem CommandResult with accepted=true.
event.trigger: A buyItem command for the locally controlled hero resolves accepted=true.
event.committedSource: SimCommand 'buyItem' -> CommandResult { accepted: true, reason: null }
event.notFrom: Do not infer from gold text, an owned item button becoming disabled, or a predicted balance.
event.boundaries: One cue per accepted committed buy result for the local player; never on click/submission alone and never for AI shop commands.

cues.audibleIntent: Two short tones falling a fourth; the opposite contour of purchase-ok so rejection is distinguishable by shape, not only by loudness or a different pitch register.

event.label: purchase denied
event.consumerAccess: Match.step() results: the submitted buyItem CommandResult with accepted=false and its reason.
event.trigger: A shop-originated buyItem command for the locally controlled hero resolves accepted=false with a committed rejection reason.
event.committedSource: SimCommand 'buyItem' -> CommandResult { accepted: false, reason: 'notEnoughGold' | 'alreadyOwned' | 'unknownItem' }; the reason must travel with the event for diagnostics.
event.notFrom: Do not infer from a disabled button, gold below the item cost, a repeated click, or a HUD message timer.
event.boundaries: Only rejections of the local player's shop buy attempts; generic command guards (invalidHero, heroDead, matchEnded) are not presupposed to be this cue and must be mapped explicitly by the wiring owner.

cues.audibleIntent: Three rising tones, each articulated by the 5 ms edge guard; a single positive growth phrase, not a fanfare loop.

event.label: hero level up
event.consumerAccess: Not exposed yet; add a formal committed level-change event in the simulation before wiring.
event.trigger: A committed experience award raises the locally controlled hero's level; use the committed fromLevel/toLevel transition.
event.committedSource: Simulation grantXp() level advance (hero.level increases after xp crosses xpLevels[hero.level]).
event.notFrom: Do not infer from the HUD level text, the health or mana bar filling, or any countdown/number redraw.
event.boundaries: One cue per committed grant for the local player even if a single award crosses multiple levels; report the final level. The committed transition exists in simulation but is not yet emitted as a PresentationEvent; wiring needs a formal committed event first.

cues.audibleIntent: One soft rising glide, single gesture; an availability cue rather than a second death or damage sound.

event.label: hero respawn ready
event.consumerAccess: Not exposed yet; add a formal committed respawn event in the simulation before wiring.
event.trigger: The simulation commits the locally controlled hero's respawn transition, alive false -> true, when respawnAtTick is reached.
event.committedSource: Simulation updateRespawns() sets entity.alive=true at the committed respawn tick.
event.notFrom: Do not infer from the HUD 'Respawn in 0s' text, a UI-side max(0, ceil(...)) countdown, or a client timer that reaches zero.
event.boundaries: Only the player's own committed respawn transition; one cue per transition, not per frame or per countdown redraw. The transition exists in simulation but is not yet emitted as a PresentationEvent; wiring needs a formal committed event first.
